description: Files the application with the government portal. Irreversible: confirm with the human first. There is no dry run: visarun_validate_application checks readiness. Refused with 422 while answers are missing or invalid, 402 until the account holder pays on the application's page in the app (links.ui of visarun_get_application), and 409 ONLINE_ROUTE_NOT_ELIGIBLE where a card of the questionnaire closes the online route for the answers and it is not paid (retrying does not help: contact Visarun); an application already submitted answers 200 with already_submitted: true and files nothing again.
name: visarun_submit_application
title: Submit application
